economy.summary: Says rising costs against stagnant wages have created an affordability crisis and proposes a universal basic income, a living wage, national grocery stores, free high-speed public transit, and gigabit broadband for every household. Also proposes a Workers' Bill of Rights.
economy.short: Proposes universal basic income, living wage, national grocery stores, free transit.

taxes.summary: Supports raising taxes on the wealthy so they pay what he calls their fair share, to fund social programs and services for working-class families. Says he has never accepted corporate PAC money.
taxes.short: Supports taxing the wealthy more to fund working-family programs.

abortion.summary: His campaign platform includes protecting reproductive freedom alongside Medicare for All. As a state representative he supported legislation to protect the reproductive rights of women and the medical professionals providing treatment.
abortion.short: Supports reproductive freedom; backed state legislation protecting abortion providers.

education.summary: Proposes universal childcare from birth to age five, an equitably and fully funded K-12 public school system, free public colleges and vocational training, and better pay for teachers.
education.short: Proposes universal childcare, fully funded schools, free college, better teacher pay.

healthcare.summary: Supports Medicare for All as part of a set of universal basic guarantees. Also supports reversing Medicaid cuts, capping prescription drug prices, and decoupling health coverage from employment.
healthcare.short: Supports Medicare for All, drug price caps, reversing Medicaid cuts.

energy.summary: Supports a just transition to 100% renewable energy, a Civil Climate Corps to create green union jobs, modernized energy grids, and a decarbonized society; opposes hyperscale data centers.
energy.short: Supports 100% renewable transition, Civil Climate Corps; opposes hyperscale data centers.

guns.summary: As a state representative, supports allowing municipalities to enact their own local firearm regulations, saying rural and urban communities should control firearms in ways that serve their populations. His campaign platform proposes reducing violence through investment in housing, education, jobs, and mental health care rather than over-policing.
guns.short: Supports local firearm regulation authority; proposes community investment to reduce violence.
